fluid.property_assumption: Pure-water approximation to 100 mM PBS; no measured PBS viscosity for this experiment.
fluid.diffusivity_note: Table 4 infinite dilution water at 25 C: (7.294 ± 0.032)e-10 m2/s; approximate 24 C adjustment using T/mu. No fitted diffusivity.

geometry.model: Monodisperse representative spheres tangent to lower plate, randomized in one layer. No-slip top and side walls.
geometry.hydraulic_boundary: Axial periodic whole-length pressure-gradient forcing; no transverse periodicity; axial seam in bead-free slot, open for tracer. Finite geometry but developed rather than prescribed plug-flow inlet.

comparison.common_loop: Empirical nonnegative baseline-corrected blank pulse; normalize its area for shape. Preserve absolute dose and recovery ledger separately.
comparison.note: Also report published Table 1 moments separately: the blank subtraction of mean and variance assumes a linear time-invariant common measurement chain. A blank-dominated whole-loop success alone does not establish pore dispersion. No long-reactor curve may calibrate geometry, diffusivity, baseline, loop, or any extra model parameters.
